data.name: Muthlaq
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'th-l-q', meaning 'to purify, to sanctify, to cleanse'. In Islamic context, Muthlaq refers to someone who has been purified through spiritual and moral growth. It is a name of reverence and respect, often given to those who have shown remarkable devotion and commitment to their faith.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who strive for spiritual perfection and seek to purify their souls
data.numerology_meaning: Individuals with the name Muthlaq are known for their spirituality, compassion, and dedication. They have a strong sense of purpose and are often drawn to careers in spiritual or helping professions.

in_english.name: Muthlaq
in_english.meaning: Prideful, miserly, unwilling to accept other's words, wasteful with money, unwilling to earn money, fearful of losing money
in_english.long_meaning: Muthlaq: A person who is prideful, miserly, unwilling to accept other's words, wasteful with money, unwilling to earn money, fearful of losing money, and who considers his own wealth to be the only wealth. He is a person who is always worried about losing his wealth, and who is never willing to accept any advice or guidance from others. He is a person who is always looking for ways to increase his wealth, but who is never willing to take any risks or make any sacrifices. He is a person who is always complaining about the lack of wealth, and who is never satisfied with what he has. In Islamic tradition, Muthlaq is considered to be a person who is prone to pride and arrogance, and who is unwilling to accept any guidance or advice from others.
